name: Experience
description: Defines an 'experience' field type that stores a duration of work experience as a single integer number of months, with a year+month select widget, two display formatters, a 'Fresher' option, a configurable year range, and a Views numeric filter.
project_description:
Overview 
 A experience field type to save the user experience by year with month select list and display like 02 Year(s) 07 Month(s).

 This experience field type is possible to use in job portals, application forms (capture the total year of experience, relevant field experience ) and user registration.

 Features 
 
 Position of experience part labels in Advanced settings 
 Experience field with Fresher option 
 Configure the select list of year (start and end year) 
 Integrated with views module (views filter) 
 
 Documentation 
 Check the README .

 Dependencies 
 None
